title: ペルソナ2 罪

layouts.notes: The u32 at 0x800DE014 is the address of the loaded scene's text: all its messages one after another, each ended by 0x1103 (33,038 bytes in the longest of the disc's 537 scenes with text). The u32 at 0x8007B6E0 points at the window's object: +0x04 is 0x80172408 for a message window, +0x0C the address the game is reading at (it rests on the end code), +0x14 is 0x44 while it waits for a button. The u32 at 0x8007B708 is 1 while the window is up. A message is whole in memory before it types. The speaker's name is its first line. Read in a replay at 21 messages; shops and battles not checked.

sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 609, utf16le 62 characters of prose-like text
Genkan memory search during play: the game uses its own table
Replay of a Genkan savestate (docs/replay.md): the 12x12 font in memory, the window's cells and the text pointer
The disc's packed scene files, unpacked: every message decoded to proofread the table; the control words counted
notes: Own table: 16-bit glyph numbers into the game's 12x12 font. Words 0x11xx are controls without an argument, 0x12xx controls with one argument word (the layout's `codes`): 0x121D colour, 0x1205 pause, 0x1208 opens a choice of that many answers and 0x1109 waits for it, 0x120E a speaker's name by number, 0x1112 to 0x1114 the hero's names. Names put in by a code read as nothing. Partial: 40 codes the script uses are left out of the table (in doubt, 1 to 20 uses each on the whole disc) and read as U+FFFD; a choice's answers are part of its message.
